definitions.first_contact: first state tick with any enemy-owned cell inside Kubic's 8-neighbourhood vision
definitions.first_sight: first state tick with the enemy general cell inside vision
definitions.situation: state with a Kubic stack>=2 orthogonally adjacent to a visible enemy cell
definitions.raid_chain: moves linked by src == previous dst within 30 ticks (split=0 links)
definitions.tick_semantics: action at tick t reads state t-1

fog_legality.dist_gen pre-sight (hunt): NOT fog-legal - belief-level analysis vs true general
fog_legality.dist_gen post-sight: fog-legal position memory; true-map BFS assumes known terrain (caveat)

attack_margin.name: moved-dst_army over all attacks in situations

onset_to_attack.name: ticks from positive-margin onset to attack

entry_moved.name: army moved on first enemy-target move of a raid chain

big_commit_gather_frac.name: own-target move frac in prev 10 actions

big_commit_toward_frac.name: post-commit chain moves closing BFS dist to general

sight_to_first_general_hit.name: ticks sight->first move onto general tile (negative = poked before sight tick? n/a)

kill_moved.name: army moved on the killing move

defender_at_sight.name: army on enemy general at sight

departure_army.name: src army when kill chain departs

path_over_bfs.name: kill-chain moves / BFS dist from departure

failed_general_hits.name: failed hits on general before kill

toward_rate.name: per-game rate of pre-sight captures closing dist to true general

baseline.name: per-game rate available options would close dist
